verdict.rationale: Cursor publishes API docs as raw markdown plus a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec (cloud-agents-openapi.yaml) and llms.txt indexes, but there is no evidence of an interactive API reference (e.g., a Swagger/Postman-style 'try it' console) with runnable examples in-browser — the docs are static markdown/spec files, not an interactive explorer.
